criteria.description: Unify the two divergent 'canonical' builder functions (specify_cli.doctrine_service_factory / charter.activation.doctrine_service_builder) plus the inline build-raw-conditionally-wrap pattern into one function, always computing active_languages and always self-resolving org_roots.
criteria.evidence: WP01 (approved, cycle 2): unified builder charter.activation.doctrine_service_builder.build_activation_aware_doctrine_service — exactly one function constructs ActivationAwareDoctrineService (public delegates to private, verified via grep for zero duplicate constructor calls); active_languages always computed, org_roots always self-resolved (fuller behavior from each divergent builder, picked deliberately not arbitrarily). test_doctrine_service_builder_unification.py's T004 proof (cycle-2 rewrite) compares against an independently-derived raw_repository(prop).list_all() projection for all 9 gated kinds in one unstaged pass (not the tautological self-comparison from cycle 1) — proven non-vacuous by both WP01 reviewers.
criteria.notes: test_doctrine_service_builder_unification.py re-run live in this fold -- passed. This fold's sweep found that the 'always computed' active_languages claim above shipped a real regression: infer_repo_languages() returned [] (not None) for a bare project with no compiled charter and no interview transcript, and doctrine.shared.scoping.applies_to_languages_match treats active_languages=None as admit-all but [] as admit-none -- so every language-scoped built-in profile (python-pedro, frontend-freddy, java-jenny, node-norris) silently vanished from an unconfigured project's catalog (measured: 18 profiles -> 14). Two independent adversarial review lenses reproduced this live on PR #3175; landing-fold fedc41478 fixed it by making infer_repo_languages() return None only for the true no-signal-at-all case, preserving [] for a configured-but-empty answer. Red-first tests (test_bare_project_admits_language_scoped_builtin_profiles, test_resolve_tech_stack_for_profile_bare_repo_resolves_python_pedro) failed before the fix and pass after; re-confirmed live in this fold (tests/charter/test_doctrine_service_builder_unification.py + test_language_scope.py + tests/runtime/test_bridge_io.py, 65 passed).
